## V1.5.2 Release Rule

- [ ] 2-3 options were drafted for buyer-facing copy/PDP/content changes.
- [ ] Plain-text prototype or rough wireframe existed before final build.
- [ ] 3 of 5 target buyers can restate the message in their own words.
- [ ] No cultural or credibility red flag came from more than one buyer.
- [ ] Founder override, if used, is recorded in the evidence register.

## Validation

- [ ] Type-check / lint / targeted tests run where relevant.
- [ ] Happy path checked.
- [ ] Failure / empty / unavailable state checked where relevant.
